title: Rise over the bowl
technique: overhead pedestal rise at 90 degrees, 14 in to 22 in above the bowl
invariant: Stand, phone flat about 14 in above the bowl; raise it straight up slowly to about 22 in, keeping it flat and the bowl centred.
newObjects: serving_bowl (owner-approved 2026-11-16) and dessert spoon (assets.spoon, owner-approved 2026-11-16) right of the bowl
sourceSetup: Overhead 90 deg throughout, standing; lens about 14 in above the bowl rim, held 1 s, rising straight up to about 22 in from 1.0 s to 4.0 s, held to 5 s. Soup variant: the serving_bowl at the place setting, dessert spoon to the right 3/4 in clear; no hands, no people.

beats.text: Phone flat above the bowl, bowl in the middle.
Raise the phone straight up slowly; keep it flat.
Stop when the spoon is in frame.
